svg.text: Playa Sprawler seat — flat pattern v0.1.0 (scale 1 px = 2 mm)
Body panel: 2 layers 1000D Cordura; side straps 25 mm tubular webbing full length; pockets double layer; seam allowance 15 mm.
BODY PANEL — front edge (top) 360 mm, rear edge 460 mm, developed length 583 mm (chord 450, sag 150)
orange = 25 mm side straps FTIP→RTIP, bar-tacked at each pocket (structural: SIDE_STRAP)
REAR (over rear tips RTIP_L/R, backrest top rail)
POCKET 1: wall 101 × 70 mm + bottom Ø32 mm, double layer, webbing loop
POCKET 2: wall 101 × 70 mm + bottom Ø32 mm, double layer, webbing loop
POCKET 3: wall 101 × 70 mm + bottom Ø32 mm, double layer, webbing loop
POCKET 4: wall 101 × 70 mm + bottom Ø32 mm, double layer, webbing loop
Cut list: body ×2 (outer + liner), pocket wall ×4, pocket bottom ×4, side strap ×2 (703 mm), front-edge webbing ×1 (480 mm).
Proof-load every finished seat to 1.5 × class payload (docs/10 T-5) before labelling.
